description: Type-safe URL state for React, Next.js, React Router and Remix
rules: Import useUrlState from 'state-in-url/next' (Next.js App Router), 'state-in-url/react-router' (React Router v7), 'state-in-url/react-router6' (React Router v6) or 'state-in-url/remix' (Remix v2); the bare 'state-in-url' export has only framework-agnostic helpers
Pass a plain JSON-serializable object with default values as the state shape; keep it in a module-level const so the reference is stable across renders
Never mutate urlState; call setUrl or setState with a new object or an updater function, same API as React.useState
Keep total URL state under ~12KB; CDNs and web servers reject longer URIs (see Limits.md)
